note: ADR-0005 §8.4: which registry rows form the works layer snapshot (atlas-works-<hash>.snap) instead of the core snapshot.  An entity is in the works layer iff its id starts with one of `entity_id_prefixes`; a claim iff its id starts with `claim_id_prefix`.  Read by atlas/ingest/works (ids it writes) and by atlas-core (compile scope).  A core claim that refers to a works entity makes the core compile fail.
